summary:
bash: # Step 2: Configure ACLs on /srv/shared
# Set current ACLs: research group rwx, alice rwx, bob rwx, others ---
setfacl -m g:research:rwx /srv/shared
setfacl -m u:alice:rwx /srv/shared
setfacl -m u:bob:rwx /srv/shared
setfacl -m o::--- /srv/shared

# Set default ACLs for inheritance: research group rwx, alice rwx, bob rwx, others ---

setfacl -d -m u:alice:rwx /srv/shared
setfacl -d -m u:bob:rwx /srv/shared
setfacl -d -m o::--- /srv/shared

# Set the mask to rwx to ensure ACL entries are not restricted
setfacl -m m::rwx /srv/shared
setfacl -d -m m::rwx /srv/shared

echo "=== Current ACLs ==="
getfacl /srv/shared
